AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
February 10, 2010
5:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

1.
Azusa Rock Quarry Modification to Conditional Use Permit C-89-20, Development Agreement, Revised Reclamation Plan Applicant: Vulcan Materials Company
Location: Existing Azusa Rock Quarry, 3901 Fish Canyon Road
Vulcan Materials Company, Western Division (Applicant) has submitted an application to the City of Azusa for a Revised Conditional Use Permit (Modification to C-89-20), a revised Reclamation Plan and a Development Agreement to modify the existing mining areas and reclamation approach at its existing Azusa Rock Quarry. A Draft Environmental Impact Report has been prepared for this project and is available for review at the City of Azusa Library, 729 N. Dalton Avenue, and in the City Clerk’s office and the Planning Division office at 213 E. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa.
2.
Use Permit UP 2009-04 Applicant: Clearwire, LLC
Location: 791 S. Azusa Avenue
Use permit to allow Sprint Nextel to modify an existing telecommunications facility, by co-location on (3) existing antenna sectors with (1) panel antenna and (1) parabolic antenna per sector.
3.
Use Permit UP 2009-05 Applicant: Lior Avraham, BCI Communications/
(representative for Sprint Nextel)
Location: 900 E. Alosta Avenue (Citrus College Shopping Center)
Use permit to allow Sprint Nextel to modify an existing telecommunications facility, by co-locating on three (3) existing antenna sectors with one (1) panel antenna and one (1) parabolic antenna per sector.
4.
Use Permit UP 2009-06 Applicant: Clearwire, LLC
Location: 137 E. First Street (Rodeway Inn Property)
Use permit to modify an existing pole sign that houses a Sprint Nextel telecommunication facility, by co-locating on (3) new antenna sectors with (1) panel antenna and (1) hybrid antenna per sector.
